node.title: Re^2: Problems Getting the Template Correct when Using unpack()
node.author: ozboomer
node.doctext:
By way of some more clarification, BTW...

From reading [doc://pack], there was something about how 'A' strips whitespace, etc and 'a' doesn't do that when using [doc://unpack]. For no particular reason, I wanted to retain the entire field, hence the usage of 'a' in the template.
